calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for MIRAGGIO
calls.summary: The team discussed creating a robust experimentation program to enhance revenue and conversion rates, targeting 50 experiments annually due to their monthly traffic of over 1.5 million, primarily from India. The current conversion rate sits between 0.6% and 0.65%, with a potential 0.2% lift from successful experiments translating to an additional ~1 million USD in monthly revenue. Technical integration with GrowthBook was highlighted, focusing on its capability for hybrid testing with Shopify to manage both client-side and server-side experiments. Various pricing options for GrowthBook were debated, including open-source and enterprise plans starting at $50,000 annually, while the decision-making process will involve key stakeholders evaluating the platform's suitability for their needs.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Experimentation, Conversion Rate, Shopify Integration, Feature Flags, CRO
